summary: Cold baseline of assembled-0226: the model is not ready for a designer. Credited region scores are R01 2.5, R02 3.3, R03 3.6, R04 2.9, R05 5.0, R06 2.8, R07 3.0, R08 1.7, R09 1.2, R10 4.2, R11 1.2 and R12 1.0. Only 12 of 80 criteria pass outright, and 9 of those 12 are measured width or overlap checks; just 3 of 54 visual criteria pass. The silhouette is close only where the measurements say so: ear span, front neck, shoulders and waist, and the side head band. The read fails at a glance in four places. (1) From behind and above, the fan is a smooth basin with a disc where it meets the neck, so the head reads as a goblet on a stalk. The fan front is a crinkled leaf with thorns, with no pointed locks and no pale inner tuft. (2) The face has disc eyes standing proud of the brow, a uniform raised ring, a bead nose and a knob under the mouth. (3) The trunk is a tube in profile with a belt crease at the hips. There is no shoulder cap, and the upper arm has a flat facet. (4) The lower legs are columns about twice the sheet ankle width, with a double swell. The hind paws are four equal beads, and the forepaws read as buds from the front. The tails are the strongest part: three crescents close to r03 from behind, which improves open invariant I05 over the 0205 baseline. They still fan apart like blades in profile, and the root has creases, no shared sheath and no overlap onto the far buttock. The fan is far more detailed than the smooth body, so the model mixes two levels of development and two coat idioms. All settled invariants hold (I09 height 1.8556), except I05, which is still open. Five posed measurements added afterwards (model posed hands on hips against the sheet: trunk, arm, thigh, shin, foot) all fail and are included in these scores.
